Cc: Colin Park <colin@oliveapps.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T16:12:00Z
Subject: Trial extension/top-up request

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the earlier trial — Olive Apps has been poking around the Redwood API for the past week. We ran basic text-generation and a couple of embedding experiments but hit the free-credit cap much faster than we expected. We were hoping to request a small one-time boost or a short extension so our ML lead can run a ~200k-record embedding pass and validate retrieval quality.

Quick context: we signed up via self-serve on 2026-05-12 (new PLG signup). Our trial ID is OLIVE-TRIAL-329. Expected usage for the embedding pass is ~10k-15k embedding requests (batching possible) — rough estimate of 9k-12k credits.

If there’s a self-serve way to top up, happy to do that; otherwise can you advise on a short-term promotional grant (~10k credits or 14-day extension)? We’re on a tight deadline for a demo to a prospective partner the week of June 7.

Attaching a short summary of the evaluation plan. Appreciate any help — happy to hop on a quick call.

Attachments:
- olive_trial_request.pdf (plan + expected usage)

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Cho

Hi Emma — thanks for the details and for attaching the plan. Looping in Marissa (Growth) and Dev (Billing) to review a short promotional grant.

A couple quick asks to speed approval:
- Can you confirm the account email that used the self-serve signup (OLIVE-TRIAL-329 is helpful) and whether you expect most embedding calls to be batched (yes/no).
- Is the June 7 demo internal-only, or will you need us to coordinate any data privacy / region routing for EU traffic? (we can set region routing but need heads-up).

If Marissa approves a one-time top-up over our $500 self-serve threshold, we will manually issue credits and provide a redemption link. If not, we can offer a 14-day extension instead. I’ll hold off on manual action until we have Marissa’s go-ahead.

— Diego

Date: 2026-05-23T14:22:00Z
Subject: Onboarding boost issued — next steps + activation tips

Emma — we’ve issued the promo package described below to account OLIVE-TRIAL-329:
- 10,000 trial credits added (one-time top-up)
- 14 additional days on the trial clock (expires 2026-06-06 UTC)

How to redeem: log into the Console > Billing > Promotions and click the pending credit. This is self-serve — I’ve also pasted the direct redemption link here: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/promotions/redeem?code=OLIVE-TRIAL-329-BOOST (expires 2026-06-06).

Because you mentioned low activation so far, a few quick activation tips that historically help teams get value out of a short window:
- Batch embeddings by 8–16 to reduce per-call overhead; we’ll automatically route to batch workers when appropriate.
- Use the small-embedding pipeline (float16 + 8-bit quant) for initial pass — it’s faster and cheaper for exploratory quality checks.
- If you’re testing retrieval, seed with 1k high-quality examples first to verify precision before completing the full pass.
- If you want, schedule a 30-minute quickstart walkthrough and we’ll debug batching/throughput live (Calendly link: https://calendly.com/diego-fernandez/redwood-quickstart-30m).

We’ll monitor activation on our side; I’ve added a task to check usage in 7 days and follow up with targeted nudges if activation is still low. If you run into any quota or region issues, reply here and we’ll escalate.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
